adjudication.rationale: In spec/jobs/poll_feed_spec.rb, the tests only cover the guard conditions in execute (feed_polling_enabled?, feed_polling_url.present?, embed_by_username.present?) and that execute delegates to poll_feed. They do not exercise the substantive logic added in Jobs::PollFeed#poll_feed: `SimpleRSS.parse open(...)`, the `url = i.link; url = i.id if url.blank? || url !~ /^https?\:\/\//` fallback, `CGI.unescapeHTML(i.content.scrub)`, or calling `TopicEmbed.import(user, url, i.title, content)` for each item. This is a concrete, diff-grounded gap in test coverage for newly introduced behavior.
